verdict.rationale: dLocal documents its own card acceptance through a custom API form, Smart Fields, or a ready-made Checkout Redirect. It also offers no-integration Payment Links pitched as letting you 'go to market in no time', and sandbox credentials are available right after login. However, nothing shows how long it takes to go from signup to accepting a live card payment; sandbox payments are simulations, not real transactions. missing for 10: evidence that production/merchant approval can complete within a day, documented self-serve signup-to-live timeline, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-live-card-payment

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Payment links allow you to collect payments securely and go to market in no time... it requires no integration.
